name: 募集している担当シフト一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Edit target Image1 LH11-0014 v001. Change ONLY the GREEN COLOR of all THREE small white-center ring markers: dark muted forest green #1F6444, no bright emerald/neon, no glossy gradient. Keep each marker's exact size, white core, shape, stroke and position. Image2 ORIGINAL Grab Driver source remains authoritative for marker geometry, proportions, spacing, alignment and fine details; Image3 mock is secondary Japanese content guide. Official forest palette overrides original brighter green. All other pixels/content/typography/layout/white surfaces/borders/shadows stay unchanged. Preserve three rows, all Japanese times/counts/team names, Meiryo role typography and neutral text. No extra symbols or actions. Static candidate only.
reviewNotes: v002実画像を原画/v001と比較。白芯リングの形状を保ち三つとも落ち着いた森林緑へ修正。三行の時刻/残人数/場所チーム名、白面/整列/分割線/切れなしを保持。原画細部優先と正式配色を適用。正確な書体同定/実予約/空席データ連携は未検証、画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

value.description: 開始終了と場所、役割のあるシフト候補一覧
